name: Painted meadow
one_line: Wildflowers, dry-stone walls and heaped summer clouds.
look_words: A summer meadow painted by hand. Fresh greens and butter yellows, pale stone walls and a sandy lane, soft rolling hills, an oak for shade, and a blue sky with heaped white clouds. Brush strokes are visible, edges are loose, and far hills are simpler and bluer than near ones. The sun is warm and fairly high; shadows are cool and soft. Bright yellow and poppy pink mark what to collect and the goal, red is harm, and the player wears cornflower blue. Motion is gentle: grass in the wind, cloud shadows crossing the field, butterflies, a stream. Avoid sharp digital edges, flat lawn green, grey skies, heavy darkness and bloom.

palette.name: summer meadow
palette.notes: Meadows are full of small yellow flowers: keep scenery flowers pale and small so the bright yellow pickups still stand out.
